limitations: The positive LUKS2 header is synthetic and has no usable encrypted keyslot/data.
The negative image is real ordinary LUKS2 without dm-integrity; its disposable random key is not retained.
Memfd seals run on the compiler pod Linux kernel, not a confidential guest kernel.
No real CDH/authority channel, key retrieval, opener, mount, initialization or runtime installation was added.
Journal enforcement, effective kernel stack checks and corruption/recovery remain required.
